mapper.insert: insert into simulation_family( progress_id, family_name, birth_date, gender, is_applicant, is_original_head, original_relationship ) values( #{progressId}, #{familyName}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{isApplicant}, #{isOriginalHead}, #{originalRelationship} )
mapper.select: select * from simulation_family where progress_id = #{progressId} and is_applicant = 1
